anua-azelaic-acid-10-hyaluron-redness-so: Gentle on sensitive skin and better for redness than stubborn marks; some find it sticky.
avene-cicalfate-restorative-protective-c: Thick and soothing for redness-prone skin, but a good number get clogged pores or find it heavy.
avene-thermal-spring-water: A calming mist for irritated, flushed skin, though a couple found it did little or dried them out.
beauty-of-joseon-ginseng-cleansing-oil: Gentle makeup remover that some say breaks down blackheads; a few broke out or felt flaky.
beauty-of-joseon-green-plum-refreshing-c: Very gentle, non-stripping foam, though a few felt it did not clean well enough or clogged pores.
beauty-of-joseon-radiance-cleansing-balm: Removes makeup and sunscreen and rinses cleanly; a few find it stings the eyes.
beauty-of-joseon-relief-sun-aqua-fresh-r: Lighter and less shiny than the original, but the main gripe is pilling when layered.
beauty-of-joseon-relief-sun-rice-probiot: Moisturizing, with little eye stinging; breakouts and a very dewy finish bother some.
bioderma-sensibio-h2o-micellar-water: Gentle enough for rosacea-prone skin, though some report irritation or breakouts.
cerave-acne-foaming-cream-cleanser: Benzoyl peroxide wash that clears acne without drying, but a few say the reformulation stings.
cerave-hydrating-cream-to-foam-cleanser: Light foam that removes makeup, though nearly as many find it drying, stinging or smelly.
cerave-resurfacing-retinol-serum: Gentle starter retinol for sensitive skin, but some purge for a long time.
cerave-skin-renewing-night-cream: Rich yet not greasy, and fine over tretinoin; a few dislike the small jar.
cerave-ultra-light-moisturizing-lotion-s: Matte finish that sits well under makeup and suits oily skin, though a few found it greasy.
cetaphil-gentle-skin-cleanser: Lotion-like and kind to reactive skin, but long-time users say the reformulation irritates.
cosrx-advanced-snail-92-all-in-one-cream: Sticky gel cream for oily skin and warm weather; dry skin needs a richer cream layered over it.
cosrx-aloe-soothing-sun-cream-spf-50: Hydrating with no white cast, a favourite for cooler days; the fragrance is the most common gripe.
cosrx-full-fit-propolis-synergy-toner: Hydrating toner with a glow that calms redness; a few noticed newer bottles smell off.
cosrx-salicylic-acid-daily-gentle-cleans: Gentle salicylic wash for blackheads and oil, but long use can bring dryness or peeling.
eltamd-uv-clear-broad-spectrum-spf-46: Light and non-greasy on acne-prone skin; complaints spread across pilling, breakouts and stinging.
first-aid-beauty-pure-skin-face-cleanser: Decade-long users find it gentle for sensitive skin; the reformulation disappoints some.
first-aid-beauty-ultra-repair-cream: Thick but spreads easily, calming dry skin in winter; irritation, often blamed on eucalyptus oil.
haruharu-wonder-black-rice-moisture-airy: Velvety finish for oily skin and a favourite for many, though some dislike the smell.
la-roche-posay-cicaplast-balm-b5: Rich balm for barrier-stressed skin, but a good number break out and it can feel greasy.
la-roche-posay-toleriane-double-repair-m: Lightweight and non-greasy on oily skin, though a couple found it greasy or stinging later.
mario-badescu-drying-lotion: Overnight spot treatment that shrinks whiteheads by morning; weaker on deep spots and may burn.
naturium-azelaic-acid-emulsion-10: Moisturizing yet light with little irritation, though a couple found the texture grainy.
naturium-retinaldehyde-cream-serum: A gentle retinal good for glow and value; some report small pimples or dry eyes.
neutrogena-hydro-boost-gel-cream-extra-d: Fragrance-free and light even on oily skin, but very dry skin or winter needs something richer.
paulas-choice-10-azelaic-acid-booster: Clears skin and fades marks even when sensitive; several get pilling under sunscreen.
paulas-choice-clinical-1-retinol-treatme: Effective without irritation for long-term users, though the cost is hard to sustain for some.
skin1004-hyalu-cica-water-fit-sun-serum: Dewy sunscreen serum moisturizing enough to skip a cream; stinging near the eyes is the gripe.
skin1004-madagascar-centella-ampoule: Watery ampoule that calms redness and a stressed barrier; some break out and a few notice nothing.
supergoop-mineral-mattescreen-spf-40: Primer-like matte tint for oily skin under makeup, though some find it drying or pricey.
supergoop-unseen-sunscreen-spf-50: Clear and primer-like under makeup, but the silicone feel divides people and some find it greasy.
tatcha-the-dewy-skin-cream: Rich night or winter cream for dry skin; breakouts and a heavy feel are the downsides.
tatcha-the-rice-wash: Creamy and non-stripping, even on dry skin, though some dislike the fragrance or the price.
tatcha-the-water-cream: Gel-like daytime moisturizer for oily skin under makeup, but price is a recurring complaint.
the-inkey-list-10-azelaic-acid-serum: Absorbent and soothing for redness, often preferred to The Ordinary's; others had a bad breakout.
the-ordinary-azelaic-acid-suspension-10: Calms redness and fades marks, but the thick texture pills over other products for many.
torriden-dive-in-soothing-cream: Cooling gel moisturizer for oily skin in humid weather; dry skin and winter need something richer.
vanicream-moisturizing-cream: Thick, fragrance-free and good value for irritated skin, but slow to absorb and can sit on top.
